```artifact
## UTP Test Suite for U08_Alarms

**Test Case ID** | **Title** | **Requirement ID** | **Kind** | **Preconditions** | **Input** | **Steps** | **Expected**
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
TC-001 | Low pressure alarm logs onset and reset | RW-SW-85 | Positive | - | - | 1. Simulate low inspiratory pressure. 2. Verify alarm is triggered. 3. Simulate pressure above threshold. 4. Verify alarm is reset. | Alarm logs onset and resets.
TC-002 | High pressure alarm triggers with threshold breach | RW-SW-88 | Positive | - | - | 1. Set pressure threshold. 2. Simulate pressure above threshold for 3 consecutive breaths. 3. Verify alarm is triggered. | Alarm triggers with high priority.
TC-003 | High pressure alarm sound emitted | RW-SW-89 | Positive | - | - | 1. Trigger high pressure alarm. 2. Verify sound is emitted. | Sound is emitted.
TC-004 | High pressure alarm persists until cancelled | RW-SW-90 | Positive | - | - | 1. Trigger high pressure alarm. 2. Simulate pressure below threshold. 3. Verify alarm remains active. | Alarm persists until cancelled.
TC-005 | Alarm management supports silent alarm state | RW-SW-91 | Positive | - | - | 1. Set alarm to silent state. 2. Trigger alarm. 3. Verify alarm is visible but silent. | Alarm is visible but silent.
TC-006 | PIP too high alarm has high priority | RW-SW-93 | Positive | - | - | 1. Set commanded PIP value. 2. Simulate PIP above threshold. 3. Verify alarm is triggered with high priority. | Alarm is triggered with high priority.
TC-007 | Default PIP too high alarm value | RW-SW-94 | Positive | - | - | 1. Verify default value is commanded PIP + 5cm H2O. | Default value is commanded PIP + 5cm H2O.
```
